description: This file defines interfaces and structures related to warning reporting, including warning event handling and control mechanisms within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for warning event objects, providing methods for serialization, deserialization, categorization, and string representation.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface for warning reporting units responsible for handling warning events and category management.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit::IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Control interface nested within IWarningReportingUnit for configuring warning categories and exclusions.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Method to report a warning event with an identifier.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Method to retrieve information about a warning category, such as default status, enabled state, exclusions, and configuration.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Method to add a warning reporting control to the category list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Method to remove a warning reporting control from the category list.
